name: MM-IFEval
intro: MM-IFEval 是 MM-IFEngine 论文提出的多模态指令遵循评测基准，用于评估多模态模型是否能同时遵循输出组合约束与图像相关感知约束。它由 MM-IFEngine 生成的图像-指令对和人工标注构建，包含 400 道挑战题，其中 300 道为组合级开放题、100 道为感知级问题，并结合规则验证与 judge 模型评分。
org: Fudan University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai Innovation Institute
build_method: MM-IFEngine生成, 人工标注, 后处理复核
eval_feature: 组合级约束, 感知级约束, 规则验证, Judge模型
eval_feature_en: Compose-level constraints, Perception-level constraints, Rule-based checks, Judge model
intro_en: MM-IFEval is a multimodal instruction-following benchmark introduced by the MM-IFEngine paper. It evaluates whether MLLMs can follow both compose-level output constraints and perception-level constraints tied to images. It is built from MM-IFEngine-generated image-instruction pairs with human annotations, contains 400 challenging questions, and combines rule-based checks with a judge model.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect diverse images from natural scenes, user interfaces, diagrams, charts, and math problems"] --> B["Filter irrelevant or low-quality images before instruction generation"]
    B --> C["Use MM-IFEngine and GPT-4o to generate or refine image-grounded tasks"]
    C --> D["Integrate six main constraint groups and 32 subcategories into the instructions"]
    D --> E["Apply human annotation to resolve complex compose-level and perception-level requirements"]
    E --> F["Post-process with model checks to mitigate conflicting constraints"]
    F --> G["Construct 400 MM-IFEval questions: 300 compose-level and 100 perception-level"]
    G --> H["Score responses with rule-based verification plus a judge model and report accuracy"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.07957 / ICCV 2025 MM-IFEngine and the official project. The paper constructs MM-IFEval from MM-IFEngine-generated image-instruction pairs, filters diverse images, uses 16 task descriptions and 32 constraints, applies human annotation plus conflict mitigation, builds 400 questions split into 300 compose-level and 100 perception-level items, and scores with rule-based checks plus a judge model.
